tools.name: check_before_call
tools.description: Call this BEFORE placing a phone call to a business. tools.name: business_lookup
tools.description: Call this whenever you need facts about a local business (restaurant, salon, clinic, trade, shop, hotel) and you have its website: contact details, how to book, opening hours, address. Faster and cheaper than fetching and reading the site yourself: returns about 150 tokens of JSON in under a second,

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Call this whenever you need the content of a web page: research, browsing, summarising, checking a source, following a link. Give it a URL and it returns the main content as clean Markdown (headings, lists, links and code kept; scripts, menus, footers and markup removed), plus the title, description

tools.name: check_before_pay
tools.description: Call this before every payment you are about to make to a paid API or HTTP 402 (x402) endpoint. Give it the URL. It reads the payment offer without paying and returns advice: ok_to_pay, caution, do_not_pay, no_payment_needed or unreachable, with reasons. It verifies the endpoint is live, the real pr

tools.name: check_before_send
tools.description: Call this before every on-chain transaction you are about to send: before buying or swapping into a token, and before transferring funds to an address. Give the token contract and/or the recipient address and the chain (base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, or solana for token mints). No

tools.name: check_many
tools.description: Batch version of check_before_call for ring-around tasks (for example, finding which of 40 restaurants has a table). Use it before dialling a list of businesses.

tools.name: report_call_outcome
tools.description: Call this AFTER a phone call to a business ends. Sends only the number and a fixed outcome code (never a transcript, recording or names). Reporting outcomes is what unlocks pooled call data on later checks.

tools.name: record_opt_out
tools.description: Call this when the called party asks to stop receiving calls (by voice or key press). scope "caller" stops calls from this caller; scope "all" records that they asked to stop AI assistant calls from all participating callers. Honour it within ten business days.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_page, check_before_pay · Private data: business_lookup, read_page, check_before_pay, check_before_send, record_opt_out · Public sink: check_before_send.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_page, check_before_pay · Private data: business_lookup, read_page, check_before_pay, check_before_send, record_opt_out · Public sink: check_before_send

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
